name: CARISOPRODOL / MELOXICAM 200MG/15MG 7 TABLETS
description: Carisoprodol/meloxicam 200 mg/15 mg, available in a 7-tablet presentation and marketed under the brand name Dorsal, is a combination medication that acts as a muscle relaxant and nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID). It is used to relieve pain and inflammation in acute cases of muscle contracture. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
